messages:
inc-bot: ALERT: Multiple ILB healthcheck failures observed for customer-private-vpc projects in us-east1 -> increased 5xxs for private endpoints. Pager triggered. severity=sev2

maria: I’m on it — paged. seeing spikes in 502/504s from our proxy pool to ILB in us-east1. initial hypothesis: healthcheck failures + header rewrite from auth proxy.

sam: Confirming, dashboards show config-change? No recent rollout in routing layer from our side (last deploy 4h ago).

andrew: Looking at GCP healthcheck logs — probes are failing with connection reset; backend VM logs show 401s to our auth service. Could be auth provider rejecting probes because header was stripped.

kevin: @maria any customer impact list? Are Dedicated/Private customers reporting errors?

maria: CS has 4 customers paging via support; some report request-level failures and timeouts for cross-region egress (eu->us). Not all customers affected, seems path-dependent.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-1929998888. Runbook: net-ilb. Oncall: maria -> sam -> andrew.

maria: Early mitigation plan: 1) stop routing healthchecks through auth-proxy for Private VPC ILB traffic (bypass) 2) add temporary accept rule for healthcheck headers 3) open ticket with GCP if route suppression seen.

sam: How do we bypass quickly? I can push a GCE firewall / proxy-route adjustment to avoid header strip.

andrew: I’ll prepare the iptables hook on the proxy side to whitelist healthcheck source ranges and skip auth header rewrite. Patch below:```
# on auth-proxy hosts
iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -s 130.211.0.0/22 -j ACCEPT
# skip auth header rewrite for healthcheck CIDRs
```

maria: Copy that. Also prepping customer comms draft. CS, please hold on a short note to impacted customers.

cs-rep: Draft ready. Short note: "We're currently investigating timeouts affecting private-vpc cross-region routing. Engineers have applied a temporary bypass; we'll update as we validate." Want to send at T+30.

kevin: Meanwhile I'm seeing error traces in our observability ingest — vendor (obs-api) returning 429s for our batched health logs around same time window. Could be correlation (backpressure). I opened support with them.

gcp-support: (automated) We see partial route suppression events in us-east1 -> us-west1 due to control-plane rate limiting on internal LB translation. We're investigating. Recommend temporary region failover.

maria: Ok, action items now: sam deploy proxy iptables skip (in 2m), andrew apply temporary ILB backend bypass (gcloud command below), kevin escalate observability 429s, cs-rep prepare customer note.

sam: Pushing change (rolling restart auth-proxy service) — command:```kubectl -n infra patch deployment auth-proxy -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"bypass-healthcheck":"ts-1929998888"}}}}}'```

andrew: Adding backend bypass to ILB backends for affected projects:```gcloud compute backend-services update ${BACKEND_SERVICE} --region=us-east1 --global-backend-service --no-health-checks --quiet```

maria: Done with initial mitigations. Monitoring for 5xx improvement.

kevin: Observability ingest partially recovered after reducing log write rate. Vendor admits transient throttle on ingestion API key; they're increasing quota.

cs-rep: Sent customer note to affected accounts at 1929999060. One reply: "we see partial success, thanks for the quick response".

inc-bot: Update: 5xx rate down from 18% -> 3% in last 10m. Healthchecks passing for 3/4 projects.

andrew: GCP update: control-plane had brief route translation suppression while our auth-proxy modified header patterns triggered stateful re-eval. GCP SRE suggests avoid rewriting the X-Forwarded-For / health headers for ILB probes. They are clearing backlog; monitoring.

maria: Next steps: 1) replace the header-rewrite logic with path-based rule (only rewrite app traffic) 2) add e2e synthetic probes from multiple regions to detect route suppression sooner 3) postmortem once stable.

sam: I'll revert the bypass to a proper config-change in infra with tests. Plan to revert temp gcloud --no-health-checks once header rule is fixed.

kevin: Also request quota bump for obs-api and add circuit-breaker on our side to avoid cascading 429s to downstream.

gcp-support: Noted. Control-plane rate limits reduced. Recommend tracking per-project translation quotas and alert on >10% probe failures for 3 consecutive mins.

maria: Thanks team. Marking P1->P2 (service partially restored). Leaving oncall to monitor for 2 hours. Will start postmortem doc after 1h.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-1929998888 status: mitigated -> monitoring. All actions logged.

maria: Closing thread for now; keep updates in incident doc. If anything spikes, re-open here. :white_check_mark:
